content: निष्कारणम् .²1 Removing, taking away. .²2 Killing; <ab>cf.</ab> निकारण.

.{@-कारण@} ({@निष्कारण@}) {%a.%} .²1 causeless, unnecessary. .²2 disinterested, free from any motive; निष्कारणो बन्धुः. .²3 groundless, not proceeding from any cause. . ({@-णम्@} {%ind.%}) without any cause or reason, causelessly, needlessly.
